authors: Tiziana Casciaro, Amy C. Edmondson, and Sujin Jang

items.meaning: 部门孤岛，与其他群体缺乏联系的内部单位
items.definitionEn: An organizational unit that works largely in isolation and shares little knowledge with others.
items.usage: 商务比喻，指部门、职能或区域各自为政。break down silos 指改善跨部门合作。
items.exampleEn: The data stayed in separate silos until both departments adopted a shared reporting process.
items.exampleZh: 两个部门采用共享报告流程之前，数据一直隔绝在各自的部门里。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 极其，非常，带强调语气
items.definitionEn: Extremely, used informally to emphasize a quality.
items.usage: 此处是加强语气的副词。devilishly difficult 指极难解决或操作。
items.exampleEn: Reconciling three versions of the same schedule was devilishly difficult.
items.exampleZh: 要把同一份排期的三个版本协调一致，实在太难了。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 交界处，两个群体或职能需要对接的地方
items.definitionEn: A point at which groups, functions, or systems meet and interact.
items.usage: 组织语境中表示协作接口，尤其是工作相互依赖的地方。
items.exampleEn: The delay occurred at the interface between ordering and fulfillment.
items.exampleZh: 延误出现在下单与履约的对接环节。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 横向协作，跨同一组织内外不同职能或单位合作
items.definitionEn: Cooperation across functions, units, or locations rather than along a reporting chain.
items.usage: 强调跨越群体边界，把互补的技能和信息带到同一项工作中。
items.exampleEn: Horizontal collaboration allowed the legal and design teams to solve the accessibility issue together.
items.exampleZh: 横向协作让法务团队和设计团队共同解决了无障碍问题。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 互补的专业知识或能力
items.definitionEn: Different areas of knowledge or skill that work well together and fill gaps in one another.
items.usage: complementary 指互补。拼写近似的 complimentary 常表示免费的或赞扬的。
items.exampleEn: The architect and the energy analyst brought complementary expertise to the retrofit.
items.exampleZh: 建筑师和能源分析师为改造项目带来了互补的专业能力。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 取决于，把某因素作为关键条件
items.definitionEn: To depend very strongly on a particular condition or event.
items.usage: 强调某个条件对结果起决定性作用。宾语可为名词，也可用 whether 从句。
items.exampleEn: The merger hinges on whether regulators approve the deal.
items.exampleZh: 合并能否完成，取决于监管机构是否批准这笔交易。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 以极快的速度
items.definitionEn: At an extremely fast and potentially hard-to-manage speed.
items.usage: breakneck 常修饰 speed 或 pace，可用于描述变化过快。
items.exampleEn: The market changed at a breakneck pace after the new platform arrived.
items.exampleZh: 新平台出现后，市场以极快的速度变化。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 可调动的专业人才或知识资源
items.definitionEn: A shared supply of specialized knowledge or skilled people that can be drawn upon.
items.usage: pool 在这里指可供使用的资源集合。通常以 tap into 或 draw on 引出如何利用。
items.exampleEn: The firm created a directory so small offices could draw on a wider pool of expertise.
items.exampleZh: 公司建立了名录，让小型办事处也能调动更广泛的专业资源。
collocations: draw on a pool of expertise

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 跨文化或跨群体协调者
items.definitionEn: A person who uses knowledge of different groups to help them understand and work with one another.
items.usage: 此处的文化也包括部门语言、工作习惯和专业背景。可代为协调，也可帮助双方建立直接联系。
items.exampleEn: A bilingual field engineer served as a cultural broker between the vendor and the local maintenance crew.
items.exampleZh: 一位会两种语言的现场工程师帮助供应商和当地维修团队沟通，承担了跨界协调工作。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 关系黏合者，帮助不同群体建立直接联系的人
items.definitionEn: A cultural broker who helps groups develop mutual understanding and work together independently in the future.
items.usage: 此处是作者使用的组织比喻。此类协调者帮助双方逐渐掌握直接合作所需的语言和信任。
items.exampleEn: The product lead acted as an adhesive by introducing engineers to support staff and helping them develop a shared vocabulary.
items.exampleZh: 产品负责人介绍工程师与客服人员认识，帮助双方建立共同语言，起到了黏合关系的作用。
collocations: a cultural broker acting as an adhesive

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 传话人，负责在双方之间协调的中间人
items.definitionEn: Someone who carries messages or facilitates dealings between parties.
items.usage: 强调代为沟通。文中 bridge 型的 cultural broker 可让双方少改变日常工作方式。
items.exampleEn: The producer acted as a go-between for the performers and the venue staff.
items.exampleZh: 制片人负责在表演者与场地工作人员之间协调。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 短暂的，转瞬即逝的
items.definitionEn: Lasting for only a brief period.
items.usage: 可形容稍纵即逝的感受、机会或流行趋势。文中用来形容香气带来的短暂感受。
items.exampleEn: The exhibition tried to capture the ephemeral excitement of a live performance.
items.exampleZh: 展览试图捕捉现场表演那种转瞬即逝的兴奋感。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 赢得支持，使原本犹豫的人转而赞同
items.definitionEn: To persuade someone to support or approve of something.
items.usage: 可分隔为 win somebody over，代词通常放在中间，如 win them over。
items.exampleEn: A working prototype helped the founders win over skeptical investors.
items.exampleZh: 可运行的原型帮助创始人赢得了原本持怀疑态度的投资者的支持。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 一贯的做事方式或运作模式
items.definitionEn: A characteristic way in which a person or group operates.
items.usage: 源于拉丁语，常见于正式描述或调查叙述。文中指各部门各自习惯的工作方式。
items.exampleEn: The newsroom’s modus operandi was to verify each claim with two independent sources.
items.exampleZh: 这家新闻编辑部的一贯做法是用两个独立来源核实每项说法。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 以相互配合、彼此增效的方式
items.definitionEn: In a way that allows different parts to reinforce one another.
items.usage: 用于强调共同作用带来的效果。词族包括 synergy 和 synergistic。
items.exampleEn: The training and mentoring programs worked synergistically to help new hires become independent sooner.
items.exampleZh: 培训与导师制度相互配合，让新员工更快能够独立工作。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 彼此差异明显的
items.definitionEn: Very different from one another in character or background.
items.usage: 常修饰 groups、sources 或 interests。强调要整合的对象原本差异较大。
items.exampleEn: The council brought together disparate groups to agree on a shared transport plan.
items.exampleZh: 委员会召集背景差异很大的群体，共同商定交通方案。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 只发生一次的，一次性的
items.definitionEn: Happening only once rather than on a regular basis.
items.usage: 此处修饰合作项目，指临时完成一项工作之后未必继续合作。
items.exampleEn: The teams used an external facilitator for a one-off workshop.
items.exampleZh: 两个团队请外部协调员主持了一场一次性的工作坊。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 为某人的可靠性背书
items.definitionEn: To say from personal knowledge that someone or something can be trusted.
items.usage: 强调基于了解做出保证。此处通过为双方背书来建立信任。
items.exampleEn: A colleague who had worked with the contractor before vouched for her reliability.
items.exampleZh: 一位曾与这名承包商共事的同事为她的可靠性做了保证。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 解读难懂的文字、语言或表达方式
items.definitionEn: To make sense of something that is difficult to understand.
items.usage: 可用于解读代码、潦草字迹或专业术语。文中指听懂不同部门的工作语言。
items.exampleEn: The designer helped the policy team decipher the technical comments in the report.
items.exampleZh: 设计师帮助政策团队理解了报告里的技术意见。

items.meaning: 融洽且便于沟通的关系
items.definitionEn: A friendly and trusting relationship that makes communication easier.
items.usage: 常用 build 或 establish rapport with somebody。强调彼此有默契、交流自在。
items.exampleEn: The interviewer spent a few minutes building rapport before asking sensitive questions.
items.exampleZh: 在问敏感问题之前，采访者先花了几分钟与对方建立融洽关系。

items.meaning: 成长型思维，相信能力可以通过学习发展
items.definitionEn: A belief that abilities can be developed through learning and effort.
items.usage: 文中强调愿意接受挑战，尝试超出当前能力范围的机会。
items.exampleEn: A growth mindset helped the team treat an unsuccessful prototype as a chance to learn.
items.exampleZh: 成长型思维让团队把原型失败当作学习机会。

items.meaning: 深度浸入某种环境，长期接触并熟悉某事
items.definitionEn: Deeply immersed in or shaped by an activity, culture, or experience.
items.usage: 常用 be steeped in a tradition、culture 或 practice。文中指在当地岗位实际体验和学习。
items.exampleEn: The apprentice became steeped in the workshop’s methods after months of working alongside the craftspeople.

items.meaning: 内化，把经验、规范变成自身的理解或习惯
items.definitionEn: To absorb an idea or norm so that it becomes part of one’s own thinking or behavior.
items.usage: 强调理解或习惯已经融入日常行为。
items.exampleEn: Repeated practice helped the nurses internalize the new handover routine.
items.exampleZh: 反复练习帮助护士们把新的交接流程变成了日常习惯。

items.meaning: 矩阵式组织结构，员工向两个或更多单位汇报
items.definitionEn: An organizational arrangement in which employees report across two or more management lines, such as function and project.
items.usage: 典型例子是同时向职能经理和项目经理汇报。可以增加跨部门接触，也需要明确责任。
items.exampleEn: In a matrix organizational structure, an analyst may report to both a finance director and a product manager.
items.exampleZh: 在矩阵式组织结构中，分析师可能同时向财务总监和产品经理汇报。

items.meaning: 成熟的，具备完整资格或能力的
items.definitionEn: Fully developed or able to perform all parts of a role.
items.usage: 常置于名词前。文中指具备完整跨界协调能力的人。
items.exampleEn: After three months of testing, the temporary working group became a full-fledged department.

items.meaning: 让流程或合作进行得更顺畅
items.definitionEn: To make a process easier by removing friction or obstacles.
items.usage: 本文为中性比喻，指通过协调减少沟通阻碍。
items.exampleEn: A clear escalation policy greased the wheels of cooperation between the two offices.

items.meaning: 视为理所当然，默认无需质疑
items.definitionEn: To assume that something is natural, obvious, or certain without checking it.
items.usage: 本文侧重默认别人也了解自己的背景。常见 take something for granted 和 take it for granted that。
items.exampleEn: We took it for granted that the warehouse used the same product codes as the stores.

items.meaning: 好奇心，主动发问和探究的倾向
items.definitionEn: A tendency to ask questions and seek to understand more.

items.meaning: 沿职业阶梯晋升，职位逐步提高

items.meaning: 有心理安全感的，可以放心提问、承认错误或表达异议的
items.definitionEn: Free enough from fear of embarrassment or punishment to speak up, ask questions, or admit mistakes.

items.meaning: 假谦虚，表面上的自谦
items.definitionEn: A display of modesty that is not sincerely felt.

items.meaning: 使恢复活力，重新激发

items.meaning: 先入之见，未了解情况就形成的想法

items.meaning: 综合多种信息或观点，形成整体理解

items.usage: 较正式，可接 to do 或名词。ill 在此加强“无法承担”的含义。
items.exampleEn: The hospital can ill afford to lose the only technician who knows the legacy system.
items.exampleZh: 医院承受不起失去唯一熟悉旧系统的技术人员。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 向广大参与者征集想法或贡献
items.definitionEn: To obtain ideas, information, or work by inviting contributions from a large group.
items.usage: 参与群体可以是公开人群，也可以是组织内部员工。
items.exampleEn: The library crowdsourced ideas from patrons before redesigning its study areas.
items.exampleZh: 图书馆在重新设计自习区之前，向读者广泛征集了建议。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 习以为常，自然做出的行为
items.definitionEn: A learned behavior that has become automatic through repetition.
items.usage: 常用 become second nature to somebody，指练习后无需刻意思考就能做到。
items.exampleEn: After several joint projects, checking with the other team became second nature.
items.exampleZh: 一起做过几个项目后，先和另一个团队确认已经成了习惯。
